name: Scatological Happening! Saiaku no Kounai Shuudan Shokuchuudoku
original_name: スカトロハプニング!最悪の校内集団食中毒
source:
Mizushiro Suzuka strives for a disciplined daily life as the vice president of the student council.

While the school had morning classes underway, in the kitchen, meals for the students were being prepared.

The main menu was curry, and this time, a new and different roux was used.

After finishing her morning classes, Mizushiro completed her student council duties in the council room and returned to the classroom.

She then attempted to have her lunch, but…
